_comments.name: What the daemon calls itself in /help, /status and the boot announce. Default 'Leash'.
_comments.defaultCwd: Where sessions start. Empty = ~/dev if it exists, else $HOME.
_comments.claudeBin: Path to the claude CLI. Empty = auto-detect.
_comments.model: Empty = whatever your claude CLI defaults to. Or e.g. 'opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku'.
_comments.yolo: 'true' passes --dangerously-skip-permissions (headless runs can't answer prompts). 'false' uses acceptEdits.
_comments.ownerName: What the assistant calls you when reporting on background work.
_comments.ownerTz: IANA timezone for /account, /usage and /status reset clocks (e.g. 'Europe/Lisbon'). Empty = this machine's local zone.
_comments.timeoutMs: Kill a CHAT-lane task after this long. Default 30 minutes, because you're waiting on the reply.
_comments.bgTimeoutMs: Kill a BACKGROUND worker after this long. Default 8 hours, because that lane is for hour-scale jobs.
_comments.maxConcurrentWorkers: How many CLAUDE background workers run at once. Default 3, floor 1. Past it a job is never refused: it waits in the drop box in arrival order, `bg.mjs ps` lists it, and it starts when a worker exits. Codex jobs are not counted. `bg.mjs --now` starts one job past the cap.
_comments.staleSec: Ignore messages older than this (e.g. queued while the machine slept). Default 1 hour.
_comments.engine: Which engine each lane runs on by default: {"chat":"claude","bg":"claude"}. A bare string ('codex') sets both. /engine changes it for this chat at runtime, and a 'codex:' or 'claude:' prefix pins one message.
_comments.codexBin: The OpenAI Codex CLI, for the second engine (/codex, /engine codex and the rate-limit fallback). Optional: with no binary installed every Codex path says so and nothing else changes.
_comments.codexTimeoutMs: Kill a Codex run after this long. Default 30 minutes. 0 disarms the deadline. A Codex run is billed per token and cannot be steered, so an unbounded one is worse than a killed one.
_comments.codexModel: Empty = whatever the codex CLI itself defaults to. /codex model changes it for this chat.
_comments.codexEffort: Empty = CLI default. Or 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh'. /codex effort changes it for this chat.
_comments.codexAppServer: 'true' runs the Codex CHAT lane on `codex app-server`, which is what gives it mid-turn steering, streamed tool steps and a real /stop. 'false' pins it to one-shot `codex exec`. Background Codex jobs always use exec, because they must outlive this daemon.
_comments.codexHandoffNetwork: false runs the FIRST Codex turn that carries a handoff from the other engine with network access off. Model-written text entering a workspace-write run is the one exfiltration surface the handoff adds; set true only if you need that turn online.
_comments.handoffCaptureTurn: true lets the engine you are LEAVING spend one short turn writing the handoff (goal, decisions, files, open question) before the switch. false always builds it from the on-disk chat ring instead, which never needs a model to be up.
_comments.style: {"noDashes": true} rewrites em and en dashes out of every outbound reply, on both engines, leaving code spans, fenced blocks and URLs alone. Default false: the model keeps its own voice.
_comments.progress: {"background": false} turns off the live 🌙 line a background worker keeps on screen from dispatch to done. Default true.
_comments.autoCompact: {"enabled": true} lets the daemon run the same compaction /compact runs, by itself, when a chat turn ends with the session at or past thresholdPercent of its context window and nothing is queued, steered or asked and unanswered. The live message says it was automatic. cooldownMinutes is the least time between two compactions, manual or automatic. Default off, 60, 30.
_comments.wakeUp: afterRestart: true sends the chat ONE wake-up turn after a daemon restart when the last process was cut mid turn (a persisted turn-in-flight marker, not a guess from timestamps) or its last answer promised a next step, telling it to finish any unfinished work now: pending dispatches, promised deliveries, workers to collect, files written but not used. Skipped when you already sent a message after the restart, on a walled engine, on a Codex chat lane, and never twice for the same turn. afterCompact: true makes the fresh chat a compaction opens CONTINUE the summary's Unfinished work list instead of acknowledging and waiting. Both default true; a bare false turns both off.
_comments.wallGuard: The usage wall guard. Before a wall: when the live account is at or past thresholdPercent of a usage window (five hour or weekly) and no other account can take a run, every running Claude background worker that can be steered is told ONCE per window to save a checkpoint (a WIP commit on its own branch or a patch, plus a resume note in its draft report) and carry on; it is never told to stop. After the wall: with resume true, each Claude worker that died on the wall with its job unfinished is queued again at the lift, as its original brief behind a RESUME NOTE, on Claude, in the same directory, through the ordinary queue. resumeChainMax is how many automatic resumes one job gets before it goes to the chat instead. resumeMaxConcurrent is the pace: at most that many resumed jobs run at once, on top of the ordinary cap and never past it (0 = the ordinary cap alone). A resume queued more than resumeWithinMinutes after the account was ready is reported as late. A brief with the line `Auto-resume: no` is never resumed. Default: on, 95, true, 5, 2, 4. A bare false turns the whole guard off.
_comments.accountAutoSwitch: The Claude account switch before the limit. Every poll cycle, when the live account is at or past fiveHourThreshold of its 5 hour window or weekThreshold of any weekly window, the login moves to the stored account with the most weekly headroom that a lookup with its own token shows under both thresholds (never a slot that needs a login or one walled in the ledger), with one message. It never swaps back and forth: only while the live account is over, only onto an account under, and not for five minutes after any swap. `node schedule.mjs add ... --switch-account <name>` and `node bg.mjs account switch <name>` switch on a schedule or now, through the same path; `node bg.mjs account check` shows the decision on the real numbers. Default: on, 90, 90. A bare false turns it off.
_comments.logFile: Where the daemon writes its own log. Empty = the path the service manager already gives it (launchd / systemd).
_comments.bgTailMs: How often the daemon polls a detached worker's log file, in ms. This replaces the stdout pipe. Default 300.
_comments.reattachPollMs: How often to check whether a worker that outlived a daemon restart has exited, in ms. Default 5000.
_comments.runLogMaxAgeDays: Delete background run logs older than this at startup. Logs still named by a live worker are kept. Default 7.
_comments.inflightFile: Path to the live-worker registry. Empty = bg-inflight.json next to bridge.mjs. Only change it if the Leash directory is read-only.
_comments.openaiApiKey: Optional. For voice-note transcription. Usually better set as $OPENAI_API_KEY.
_comments.transcribeModel: The OpenAI speech to text model for voice notes. Empty = gpt-4o-mini-transcribe. whisper-1 still works.
_comments.env-override: Any key can be overridden with BRIDGE_<UPPER_SNAKE_CASE>, e.g. BRIDGE_DEFAULT_CWD.
